messages:
Nora (Support): Escalation: Sparrow trial tenant sparrow-trial-11 is seeing intermittent embed timeouts during a large nightly ETL. Customer has a sales demo tomorrow and said they'll pause the pilot if unresolved in 48h. @Eli can CS own? :rotating_light:
Eli (CSM): On it. Nora, paste the console alert + any SDK flags they changed. Keep the first message customer-friendly.
Nora (Support): Snippet:

```
2026-08-03T22:04:12Z ERROR embed-service tenant=sparrow-trial-11 rate=720/s limit=400/s quota_exceeded
2026-08-03T22:04:13Z WARN client sdk timeout req_id=7f4b2a
```

Nora (Support): They mentioned enabling "parallel_uploads" and a nightly ingest window at 22:00 UTC.
Jin (CS): Risk: onboarding stall -> failed demo -> renewal pressure. Proposed comms/ops plan: 1) immediate ack + ETA, 2) schedule 30m triage with eng within 3h, 3) temporary soft-limit uplift for the demo window + suggest a staggered ingest window, 4) short enablement walkthrough for SDK batching, 5) capture product feedback on SDK defaults and console alerts. Eli, want to lead external comms?
Eli (CSM): I'll lead comms and the enablement. Keep message high level. Draft to customer: "Hi Sparrow team — thanks for flagging. We're investigating throttling triggered by your recent ingest. We've scheduled a troubleshooting call with engineers and will temporarily increase throughput for your demo while we stabilize. We'll also run a short enablement session on batching and ingest scheduling. Meeting invite incoming. — Eli, CSM"
Sam (Engineer): Preliminary: client concurrency + nightly burst exhausted tenant burst credits; embed fleet in eu-west-1 at ~90% utilization. Short-term: bump soft_limit to 900/s for the demo window and enable smoothing/backpressure. Mid-term: recommend staggered ingest windows, client-side batching, and autoscale config for embed workers.
mktg-bot: [meeting] Created incident-sparrow-1876543210 at 2026-08-03T23:00:00Z; attendees: Eli, Sam, Nora, Jin
Nora (Support): Customer replied: "Thanks, we'll join. Please uplift if possible for tomorrow's demo."
Sam (Engineer): Uplift preview (will run only after call ack):

```
# preview only
PATCH /api/quotas/tenants/sparrow-trial-11 { "soft_limit": 900 }
# monitor: GET /metrics?tenant=sparrow-trial-11&window=5m
```

Sam (Engineer): I'll post exact command on the call and wait for verbal confirmation. Rollback to 400/s after demo window unless customer requests longer.
Jin (CS): Action items: - Eli: send ack + run enablement. - Sam: prep uplift command + dashboard. - Nora: collect SDK flags and failed traces. - Jin: prep AE/RevOps note if >24h.
Eli (CSM): Sent ack to customer (kept it light). Scheduling triage now. Reminder: avoid infra details externally unless asked.
Jin (CS): I'll flag renewal-watch to RevOps if mitigation crosses 24h and update account health sentiment.
Nora (Support): -- end thread --
